basis: Specified disease site is the ovary, outside the axes; the primary melanoma's organ of origin is not established.
Mitochondrial genome maintenance disorder; neurologic dysfunction and skeletal myopathy each commonly affect >30% across the spectrum; hepatic disease is subtype-dependent.
Neurologic movement disorder; abnormal muscle contractions do not establish primary skeletal muscle disease.
Defined neurometabolic disorder with excess 2-hydroxyglutarate and characteristic neurologic dysfunction; cardiac disease is subtype-dependent.
Defined disease of capillaries; no additional organ damage is shared across this vascular umbrella.
Salivary glands are the predominant origin of myoepithelial carcinoma; breast and soft-tissue variants do not establish additional shared axes.
Familial epilepsy spectrum with frequent generalized seizures; no common direct damage outside the nervous system.
Combined cellular and humoral immunodeficiency; secondary infections are separate diseases, and additional organ damage varies by subtype.
Immune-mediated inflammatory demyelination of the central nervous system.
Restrictive skin disease with short clavicles in 2/2; rectal prolapse in 1/2 supports GI involvement. Respiratory distress and proptosis alone do not establish organ injury.
Gingival fibromatosis in 9/9 defines oral disease; structural sternal abnormalities in 3/9 (~33%) support skeletal involvement.
Paraneoplastic nervous-system dysfunction is predominantly caused by antitumour immune responses targeting neural antigens.
Osteopetrosis defines bone disease; anemia, stage 3 CKD and reduced vision each occur in 1/1 reported patient. Endocrine/electrolyte findings omitted under cap; evidence is limited.
Treponemal infection characteristically produces cutaneous papillomas and ulcers; destructive bone and cartilage disease is a minority complication.
Defining absence of major brain structures and cranial vault; adrenal hypoplasia is frequent (30-79%).
Defined disease of the kidney; no additional organ involvement applies across the umbrella.
Inherited disease of hearing or the auditory apparatus; syndromic extra-auditory manifestations are not shared across the group.
Lipodystrophy/insulin resistance, Rieger anomaly and skeletal features define SHORT; hearing loss 80-99%. Dental defects and skin/subcutis changes omitted under cap.
KMT2E-related neurodevelopmental syndrome with global developmental delay, hypotonia and brain abnormalities; other findings lack qualifying frequencies.
Defined degeneration of the cerebellum; immune mechanisms apply to some causes rather than the entire umbrella.
Neoplasms originating in the heart, pericardium or vessels; no other organ involvement is shared across the group.
Congenital or early infantile vanishing-white-matter leukoencephalopathy, defined by cerebral white-matter degeneration.
Infectious diseases transmitted through sexual contact; no single anatomical axis is consistently affected across the umbrella.
Defined damage to central or peripheral nervous-system myelin; immune, metabolic and other causes vary across the umbrella.
Autoinflammatory disease; progressive sensorineural hearing loss affects roughly 40-60%. Rash/conjunctival injection are transient; destructive CNS and joint disease favor severe subtypes.
